leaderboard.style: aggregator-plus-compliment: recap thread, 'will add you', bounty-should-be-bigger, one-liner dunk on Altman merch
medium-length constructive policy take; anti-fearmongering, keep-capability-verify-access

patterns: Joke one-liners and meme images win product-launch threads; top Astra replies were courtroom joke, existential-dread meme, and a 3-word pun, all under 20 words.
Winning length is 1 line or 1 image; genuine expertise (eliebakouch, sokrypton, ohabryka) lands later and at 10-35 likes vs 100-800 for jokes.
Timing window: jokes/memes +1–20m; number-dunks (+$6500) +20–80m once the figure is in-thread; expertise +1–6h.
Hack-thread reply format collapsed to one template: bounty dunk ('Only $6,500??' / 'yikes' / verbatim-quote of the $6,500 line). Same dunkers did not farm the Anthropic or Astra threads.
Contrarian takes hit only when snappy and early (AndAIyou hypocrisy jab +3m on the OSS GPU post); slower gatekeeping complaints on LSVP stayed under 20 likes.
Data-flex / TLDR (AISafetyMemes quoting 26% / 30k agents) is the only long-form format that scored on a lab policy post, and it arrived +6h.
Community-note bait and rumor posts (Polymarket Claude-worship) attract moralizing, scripture, and shock-humor, not AI expertise.
Local-model hype (0xSero Qwen/8GB) uniquely drew eval-skeptic replies: source-please, quantization-is-dishonest, 'we've been over this.'
Named AI accounts were quiet: no sama/karpathy posts in-window; swyx/simonw were sub-10-like replies; elon volume was Starlink/culture, not models.
Cross-thread reply-farmer density is low in 24h of lab posts; dunkers specialize per story instead of sitting in every quote-tweet.
